variant.basis: The official 40×40 SVG consists of one original vector path filled #0630B8, forming a blue circular emblem with internal transparent lightning/monogram cutouts. Independent source render shows the same emblem geometry beside the bank name, but a different older blue. The official favicon and current official full logo visually agree in geometry and blue. Standalone favicon has no accompanying lettering and fits a square cell without shrinking a wordmark.
